violations.title: Hot Water and Chemical Sanitizing, Immersion Time
violations.observation: Food-contact surfaces of utensils and equipment are not being sanitized, at the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: After being cleaned, the food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in manual hot water operations by immersion for at least 30seconds at a water temperature of at least 171F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: marinated chicken=48F/50/49F, grilled sauce=50F, gallon whole milk =48F, whole butter milk=48F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Discard all of these food items.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: marinated chicken 4 and 5 days past due dates, noted in the walk-in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. Discard foods that have pasta 7 days after preparation.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper beard restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. Provide beard nets for employees to use on their beard.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR AND THE IKON 3- DOOR FLAT-TOP REFRIGERATED CONDIMENT TABLE. These two equipment are not operating properly and not able to maintain potentially hazardous foods at 41F or lower.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Remove potentially hazardous foods from these equipment and do not use until after proper repaires have been completed.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Exterior surfaces of prep table including the bottom shelving under these tables.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor under stationary and cooking equipment is in need of cleaning. The floor drain under the 3-vat sink has layers of debris, and other spoiled marterials.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. HANGRY JOE'S HOT CHICKEN & WINGS (Inspection Date: 08/31/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Mac & cheese, ranch dressing.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter and prep tables.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers that were delivered to the restaurant holding original foods such as strawberries, or other foods were observed reused for the storage of lettuce, after the original contents were used up.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor under the cooking equipment ands the floor drain under the 3-compartment sink are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
